description:
Problem: cloud sessions always select the oracle-cloud client and tailnet URL (local.py:350-366), but cloud_gateway.sh runs tailscaled in userspace mode reachable only through a local HTTP proxy (127.0.0.1:1055). reachable() (local.py:368-376) uses plain urllib and omp_env() (commands.py:14,58-60) drops HTTPS_PROXY, so every cloud make pr-open refuses with 'review unavailable'. Tests stub reachable(). cloud-builder.md:85-87 still says builders 'do without oracle reviews', which pr-open forbids.

Outcome: Credentials gains the gateway proxy read from the status file cloud_gateway.sh writes ($(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir)/benchbox-cloud-gateway.status, gateway_proxy=); reachable() uses it via ProxyHandler; omp_env() passes HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY only for the oracle-cloud client; local and CI environments stay unchanged; docs/agent/cloud-builder.md describes the real flow.

Decision gates:
1. The live cloud smoke needs a Claude cloud session (owner setup). If none is available when the code is merged, record the unit and loopback-proxy evidence, set the item blocked with reason 'cloud smoke needs owner cloud session', and continue the batch.
2. If the reviewer omp ignores HTTPS_PROXY for its provider calls, stop and ask (a gateway-side change would be needed).
